name: Antimicrobial Emollient (Dermol 500)
mechanism: Emollient with benzalkonium chloride and chlorhexidine (antimicrobial)
dosing: Apply liberally and frequently to affected areas; may be used as a soap substitute for cleansing in eczema prone to infection
contraindications: Known hypersensitivity to chlorhexidine, benzalkonium chloride or other formulation components
interactions: Avoid use concurrently with other topical antiseptics that may interact with chlorhexidine; no relevant systemic interactions
monitoring: Monitor skin for signs of irritation or contact dermatitis and for clinical response in infection-prone eczema
pregnancy: Considered safe for topical use in pregnancy; avoid unnecessary exposure
sideEffects: Rare contact dermatitis or skin irritation; hypersensitivity reactions reported in some individuals
pharmacokinetics: Acts locally on the skin with negligible systemic absorption
clinicalPearls: Useful as an antimicrobial emollient in patients with eczema prone to bacterial colonisation; suitable as a wash substitute but monitor for irritation; note fire hazard with emollient products
indication: Topical management of eczema with recurrent infection and dry skin prone to bacterial colonisation
